records.title: The largest theft in history: North Korea likely behind the $6.4 billion Binance hack
records.summary: Elliptic's 2026-10-30 19:30 UTC update estimates $6.43B stolen at theft-time and $2.84B frozen at its 12:55 UTC balance snapshot. It reports approximately $3.23B of assets beyond issuer-level freeze control, including 233M XRP, 519,104 ETH, 18,270 BTC and about 575M TRX. Elliptic says 48M RLUSD was sold before Ripple froze the remainder; it also reports stolen AVAX converted to USDC, bridged through Circle CCTP to Ethereum, then swapped for 7,242.8 ETH. Elliptic assesses DPRK-linked actors as likely, but states no government or law-enforcement agency has confirmed attribution.
records.methodology: Elliptic on-chain tracing, freeze-event analysis and cross-chain attribution; its article distinguishes theft-time values from later frozen-balance observations.
records.limitations: The 233M XRP balance is tied to the article's 2026-10-30 12:55 UTC holdings snapshot, not a fresh 2026-10-31 XRPL read. Elliptic's DPRK attribution is a private-sector assessment, not official attribution. Elliptic notes the Bitget laundering overlap is small and that the slow stablecoin conversion is atypical of prior DPRK-linked operations.

records.title: Binance hot-wallet incident — XRPL receiver and cross-chain reconstruction
records.summary: Bitquery reports five Binance-labelled XRPL accounts sent approximately 233.5M XRP to receiver rK21t6nGLy4MNDqhvy3pGwcLFy25qgfzMx. At its 2026-10-30 06:43 UTC holdings snapshot, the receiver still held approximately 233.5M XRP with no outgoing transaction. Bitquery says the XRP Ledger and Solana drains shared no address with the rest of the attack; it links them by timing, unusual transaction construction and Binance's own aggregate loss estimate.
records.methodology: Public XRPL transaction and account-balance tracing combined with provider wallet labels and cross-chain timing analysis.
records.limitations: The balance cutoff is 2026-10-30 06:43 UTC. No 2026-10-31 receiver refresh is present in this source. Address labels are provider attributions. The absence of a shared address between the XRP/Solana drains and other chains is a caution against overstating direct wallet-level linkage.

records.title: Security Incident Update #2 — company reserve, phased withdrawal restoration and Proof of Reserves targets
records.summary: Binance says it allocated more than $6.34B in company funds, with $5B already held in affected token assets, and is acquiring the remaining relevant token shortfall through market and OTC channels. It reports approximately $3B frozen on-chain. It targeted phased withdrawal restoration within approximately 34 hours, subject to security checks, an initial Proof of Reserves snapshot within 12 hours, and publication of results by 2026-11-02. It does not disclose an XRP-specific purchase or replenishment quantity.
records.methodology: Official Binance Support announcement signed by co-CEOs He Yi and Richard Teng.
records.limitations: Company statement, not independent proof of completed purchases or customer-liability coverage. The approximately $1.34B remaining acquisition estimate is not an XRP allocation. The 34-hour withdrawal target elapsed at approximately 2026-10-31 05:33 UTC, but no verified global restoration status was found by this cutoff. The 12-hour PoR snapshot target is approximately 07:33 UTC, still ahead of this cutoff; results are due by November 2.

records.title: Notice Regarding Binance Japan's Response to the Security Incident at Binance Global
records.summary: Binance Japan states that customer crypto assets are held in its own cold wallets, separately from Binance Global's affected hot wallets, and that no impact to Binance Japan customer assets was identified. It says crypto withdrawals were temporarily suspended as a precaution while deposits, trading and fiat services remained operational.
records.limitations: This is a company statement, not an independent reserve audit. Binance Japan is a separate regional entity and must not be conflated with SBI VC Trade, SBI Holdings or Japanese SBIC. The published service status is dated October 30 and requires a fresh status check.

records.title: XRP Posts Steepest Open Interest Drop in Five-Coin Snapshot
records.summary: TokenPost's 2026-10-30 23:00 UTC snapshot reports XRP perpetual-futures open interest of $329.1M, down 12.31% over 24 hours, mark price $1.25, funding +0.0033% per eight hours and 71.8% long accounts. The article does not provide a sufficiently detailed contract-universe definition to reconcile this figure with TradRadar's $1.85B or Kodexius's $734.17M snapshots.
records.methodology: Provider-supplied five-asset perpetual-futures snapshot as described by TokenPost.
records.limitations: The venue/contract universe and aggregation methodology are not fully disclosed in the article. Its cutoff is 23:00 UTC October 30, earlier than the 05:40 UTC October 31 TradRadar snapshot. Do not average or splice these OI series.

records.title: Cross Analysis scheduled run 41178286100 and main commit b28f43c
records.summary: The scheduled Cross Analysis run succeeded and pushed unsigned main commit b28f43c907517e939e299e8766e2ebe655a0df13, changing only ping-pongings/knowledge-base/sentiment_shift.json. The job log reported insufficient XRP and BTC data in both recent and prior windows (n=0). The JSON contains null scores, zero entries and null shift; the only Git diff was generated_at timestamp churn. The run then triggered a successful GitHub Pages build/deployment.
records.methodology: GitHub Actions run and job log, commit metadata and exact commit patch.
records.limitations: The sentiment output is not a measured directional signal and must not be treated as model evidence. The scheduled workflow still has contents:write and direct main push capability on main. The Pages deployment was performed by the existing workflow, not by this research run.

records.title: Scheduler Tick run 41179207610
records.summary: The scheduled Scheduler Tick job completed successfully at 2026-10-31 07:05:30 UTC. Its log says zero entries fired and one total entry remained in the queue. The queue commit step executed but git reported Everything up-to-date, so no commit was pushed. The main workflow retains contents:write and actions:write permissions and a scheduled 15-minute cadence.
records.methodology: GitHub Actions run, job step log and current main workflow file.
records.limitations: A no-op run does not remove the workflow's ability to commit queue changes or dispatch workflows when entries fire. The safety proposal remains open and unmerged.

records.title: Main branch ref, protection metadata and last full open-PR inventory
records.summary: Main is b28f43c907517e939e299e8766e2ebe655a0df13. GitHub reports protected=true, but the returned required-status-check contexts/checks arrays are empty and the full branch-protection details endpoint returned 403 Resource not accessible by integration. The last complete PR inventory at 06:42 UTC counted 173 open PRs (163 drafts, 10 ready), 171 main-based and 169 with base SHA older than 33a490e; it was not recounted after main advanced to b28f43c.
records.methodology: GitHub branch endpoint, compare API, paginated PR inventory and Actions metadata.
records.limitations: Empty returned contexts do not prove that no external policy exists; full protection details were inaccessible. The PR inventory counts are stale relative to the new main SHA and must not be presented as a current recount.

records.title: Approval workflow push-event failure with zero jobs — run 41178110937
records.summary: A push-event run of .github/workflows/barrot-approve-pr.yml completed with failure and zero jobs on research branch head 71d0d543. The inspected workflow declares workflow_dispatch only. No job logs were returned; root cause remains unknown.
records.methodology: GitHub Actions run metadata, jobs endpoint and workflow file inspection.
records.limitations: A zero-job failure is observed, but the available evidence does not identify whether the cause is workflow parsing, event routing, policy or another GitHub-side condition. Do not claim invalid YAML without job/check-suite evidence.
